milestone: Reader accessibility contrast and focus baseline
scenario: Light and dark Reader fixtures keep normal accent, warning, and muted text above the AA text threshold across the core paper surfaces; authentication and command-palette inputs expose visible keyboard focus indicators.

failure_before_repair.result: failed: light accent measured 4.2297:1 against the warm paper background and the auth focus outline resolved to an alpha rgba color; the command-palette focus assertion was not reached after the auth assertion failed

failure_before_repair.result: contrast-inclusive axe probe remained red with serious color-contrast violations across fixture card metadata and status states; this was not counted as a release pass

repair: Darkened the light-theme accent to #99441a, warning to #8c5a0b, and muted token to #6e604f so text remains readable on the core paper, inset, panel, and secondary-panel surfaces.
Replaced the translucent authentication input focus outline with an opaque accent outline and a two-pixel offset.
Added an explicit accent focus outline to the command-palette input, which previously disabled the native outline without a replacement.
Added failure-first browser baselines for both themes, the four core surfaces, and the two previously untested input focus states.

validation.command: cd apps/reader-web && READER_E2E_PORT=3034 PLAYWRIGHT_REUSE_SERVER=false npx playwright test e2e/service-worker.smoke.spec.ts -g 'muted reading|normal accent|auth and command palette|axe scan finds no critical' --project=chromium

validation.result: pass: Next.js production build and TypeScript check

known_limit: The existing axe gate still excludes color-contrast because the broader core-page probe reports additional serious violations that were not safely reducible to this token/focus slice; those remaining card/status and non-text-border findings are not claimed as fixed. This fixture-only Chromium evidence does not prove screen-reader output, native iPhone selection, Firefox/WebKit selection lifecycle, real production proxy behavior, or staging/production auth and theme persistence.
